title: Jazzy Smoky German Stew
description: A hearty stew made with smoky flavors and a hint of jazzy spices, inspired by German cuisine.

ingredients.name: German sausage
ingredients.notes: Choose a vegetarian option if preferred

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add sausage and cook, breaking up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onions and garlic and cook until the onions are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add paprika and stir to combine.
Add carrots and potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Add broth, mustard (if using), and Sevaiiya. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (if desired)
